label: sec:mass-predictions-method-feynman-qou-comparison-preamble
html: To benchmark the categorical trace calculus against standard perturbative quantum field theory, this section compares the Wedderburn channel expansion term-by-term with Feynman loop amplitudes. It evaluates the neutron–proton mass difference m_n - m_p from the single crossing-sign asymmetry of the nucleon trefoil core, traces the reduction from four covariant photon polarizations to the three Wedderburn invariants of H_3(q), and compiles the master nine-table validation scorecard across the particle spectrum.
